description: This file contains a database migration script for updating time grain settings in a Superset project, including class definitions for database models and an upgrade function that modifies query parameters.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: Represents a database with a method to retrieve available time grains.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a table linked to a database.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a data slice with parameters and datasource info.

methods.name: grains
methods.description: Retrieves available time grains for the database.

methods.name: duration_by_name
methods.description: Creates a dictionary mapping time grain names to durations.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the migration to update time_grain_sqla parameters.
